title: Architecture Decision Record
description: The single source of truth for ADR structure. hooks/validate-adr-frontmatter.sh is a thin caller of scripts/check-schema.py against this file and declares no field list of its own; scripts/tests/test-schema-field-parity.sh fails if it grows one. The validated object is built by check-schema.py: `frontmatter` is the parsed line-1 YAML block, `sections` maps each `## ` heading text to its ordinal.

frontmatter.description: Line-1 YAML frontmatter. additionalProperties stays open: this is a user-authored document in downstream repos, and blocking a Write over an unrecognised field would be hostile. The closed-block typo defence that manifest.schema.json uses is right for a plugin-controlled control surface, not for someone else's ADR.

id.description: Document ID (ADR-NNNN). Assigned by /blueprint:sync-ids when missing.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Capitalised, unlike PRP status — ADRs have used this casing since ADR-0001.

created.description: YYYY-MM-DD the ADR was first written

modified.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last substantive edit

date.description: Legacy alias for `created`, kept because templates/adr-readme.md reads it when building the index. New ADRs should set `created`.

reviewed.description: YYYY-MM-DD the decision was last re-examined

domain.description: Category scoping conflict detection between ADRs (see skills/adr-relationships)

supersedes.description: ADR this decision replaces. The target must carry the reciprocal `superseded-by`.

superseded-by.description: ADR that replaced this decision. Hyphenated to match relates-to / github-issues, which auto-sync-id-registry.sh already parses. The underscore spelling `superseded_by` was the schema's form until the SSOT reconciliation and is rejected below.

superseded_by.title: `superseded_by` (underscore) is the pre-reconciliation spelling — rename it to `superseded-by`. The hyphen form is what hooks and skills read; the underscore form is silently ignored.

extends.description: ADR this decision builds upon without replacing

then.title: status is `Superseded` but no `superseded-by` names the replacement — /blueprint:adr-validate can set both ends. Warning, not an error: a decision can be marked superseded before its replacement is numbered.
`date` is set but `created` is not. `date` is a legacy alias; set `created` (and `modified`) so the ID registry and staleness checks see the document.

sections.description: Map of `## ` heading text to its 0-based ordinal. Missing sections WARN rather than block: only 2 of this repo's 22 ADRs carry all five, and a PreToolUse block would refuse an edit to a 2026-01 ADR until someone back-wrote an Options Considered section it never had. /blueprint:adr-validate is the gate that can insist. See .claude/rules/hook-block-vs-nudge.md.
sections.title: required `## ` section missing — the ADR/PRP template declares it; add it or run the matching validate skill
